payload.description_html:
Ossified tail tendons of Stegoceras, originally thought to be gastralia. Original caption: Segments of abdominal ribs of Troodon validus (Lambe). No.2, ,Univ. of Alberta. Fig, 1-Bifurcated segments. Type four. Fig. 2-Median segments. Type four. Fig. 3-Attenuated segments. Type three. Fig. 4-Double pointed segments. Type two. Fig. 5-Heavy segments. Type one.

All figures natural size.
